# embedding model

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:embeddingModel`](gmeow-embeddingModel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/embeddingModel>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/graphrag`](../../slices/graphrag.md)

The model agent that produced this embedding. Two models' embeddings of the same chunk are two [`Embedding`](../classes/gmeow-Embedding.md) individuals — never merged (P9: machine-derived values are attributed).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Embedding`](../classes/gmeow-Embedding.md) -> [`gmeow:SoftwareAgent`](../classes/gmeow-SoftwareAgent.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:embeddingModel`](gmeow-embeddingModel.md) from [`gmeow:Embedding`](../classes/gmeow-Embedding.md) to [`gmeow:SoftwareAgent`](../classes/gmeow-SoftwareAgent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
